title: Law to screen for endometriosis and PCOS
summary: This bill would require the Department of Health and Mental Hygiene to establish a menstrual health program screening patients showing symptoms of endometriosis and polycystic ovarian syndrome (also called polyendocrine metabolic ovarian syndrome). It would let the department refer patients to related services and add these conditions to its required sexual health outreach and education topics. The law would take effect 120 days after enactment.
